reserve.title: How to book a restaurant
reserve.apps: Booking services people use in this country
reserve.note: Haru does not make reservations for you. Check availability and terms with each service.

step.need: First check whether you need a booking. Popular places, dinners and weekends usually do; markets and street food do not.
step.app: Search the restaurant name on one of the services below, then pick the date, time and party size.
step.hotel: If the app does not work, ask your hotel front desk to call for you, or phone the number shown on the map.
step.tell: When you book, say how many people, whether children are coming, and any vegetarian or allergy needs.
step.cancel: Cancel if you cannot go. Some restaurants take a deposit or charge a no-show fee.
